note: Seasonal reasons to go now, checked against official or organizer pages. Dates can change, so check the source before you go.

tags.about: Maples and ginkgos usually peak mid-to-late October.
tags.label: FallColours

burnabylakeregionalpark.why: Fall colour around the lake, plus ducks and birds to spot from the boardwalks.

campbellvalley.why: Boardwalk and forest trails that are pretty in fall colour.

deerlakepark.why: The trees around the lake change colour in October, an easy flat loop with a stroller.

godwinfarmbiodiversitypr.why: Hundreds of trees, some rare, turn colour through October.

lynnheadwaters.why: Rushing water and forest trails in fall colour.

minnekhada.why: A local favourite for fall walks and photos, with marsh and forest trails.

nitobe.why: The Japanese maples turn red and orange in October, usually at their best mid-to-late month.

pacificspiritregionalpar.why: Big trail network where the maples go yellow in October.

qepark.why: One of the city's go-to fall colour walks. Maples around the quarry garden usually peak mid-to-late October.

queenspark.why: Big old trees and a meadow that look their best in fall, next to the petting farm and playground.

redwood.why: Mixed trees around the redwood grove turn colour in fall, with a treehouse and playground.

stanley.why: The seawall near the rowing club and the Coal Harbour path turn gold and red in October.

vandusen.why: Harvest Days runs on weekends Sept 26 to Oct 18 (plus Thanksgiving Monday, Oct 12), included with admission. Sugar maples, ginkgos and Japanese maples usually peak mid-to-late October.

tags.about: Salmon return to local rivers and hatcheries in fall.
tags.label: SalmonRun

capilanoriver.why: Coho are returning now and Chinook come back in October and November. The Capilano River Hatchery has free underwater viewing windows (open 8am to 6pm in October).

capilanoriverhatchery.why: Coho are returning now and Chinook come back in October and November. The hatchery has viewing windows.

kanaka.why: Chum and coho return to the creek in fall. The Return of the Salmon event at the Bell-Irving Hatchery is on Oct 18.

tynehead.why: Adult coho, chum and Chinook return to the Serpentine River here from October to December.

tags.about: Pumpkin patches and haunted nights through October.
tags.label: Halloween

aldor.why: The pumpkin patch is open daily Sept 19 to Oct 31, 9am to 5pm, with hayrides and farm animals.

hazelmere.why: Pumpkin patch at Gabriel Farms with wagon rides, animals and a mini corn maze. Weekends to Oct 31, weekdays Oct 1 to 30 from 2 to 5pm.

playland.why: The summer ride season is over, which is why searches are down. It reopens for Fright Nights from Oct 7 to 31 (Wednesday to Sunday, from 6pm).

portkells.why: Pumpkin patch Oct 1 to 31, daily 9am to 6pm, with a cedar maze, animals and an indoor sand pit. $6.99 each, pumpkin included.

richmondcountryfarms.why: Pumpkin patch Sept 26 to Oct 31, with wagon rides, animals and live music. Weekdays 9am to 4pm, weekends 10am to 4:30pm.

westhamislandherbfarm.why: Pick your own pumpkins until Oct 31, daily 10am to 5pm, with a scarecrow display.

tags.about: Local ski hills open when the snow arrives.
tags.label: SkiSeasonSoon

cypress.why: Summer hiking is winding down and ski season is next. Projected opening is Nov 28, depending on snow. 2026/27 season passes are on sale.

grouse.why: Ski season is next. Projected opening is mid-December, depending on snow, and 2026/27 passes are on sale now.

mountseymourpark.why: Ski season is next. Mt Seymour is the family and beginner hill, with a projected opening of Dec 19, depending on snow.
